soundness_flags.label: Theorem 6 / def:centered-rectangles / def:persistent-subclass
soundness_flags.one_line: The law P_{\boldsymbol\theta_n} is never defined, and the all-ones persistent subclass fixes the target mean path rather than supplying the asserted \boldsymbol\theta_n\in\mathbb R^{H_n} Gaussian location family.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 11–13, Corollary 2 and Section 6; pp. 3–5, Assumptions 1–4 and Theorem 1; p. 13, Assumption R1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a pointwise interval in Corollary 2, then treats a prespecified finite-horizon weighted summary in Section 6; it states low-Hankel-rank temporal structure and a recursive recovery condition for fixed h.
The article develops simultaneous confidence bands for many functional parameters using approximately Neyman-orthogonal scores and high-dimensional uniform CLT/multiplier methods.
The paper gives Gaussian-maxima comparison and anti-concentration results allowing arbitrary covariance structures, with max-norm covariance discrepancies.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv record for the Annals of Probability article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives Gaussian and bootstrap approximations uniformly over hyperrectangles for independent high-dimensional sums without a correlation-structure restriction.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Machine Learning Research 26 (2025), article 117
source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1, abstract; pp. 2 and 24, Sections 1.1 and 9
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies fixed-design error-in-variables PCR, minimum-norm identification, and nonasymptotic out-of-sample prediction; it identifies inference for PCR prediction as a further research need.
The paper develops residual-bootstrap confidence intervals for treatment effects on every treated unit at every post-treatment time in interactive-fixed-effects panels.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Sections 3–4, especially discussion of honest whole-function coverage and lower bounds
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies adaptive nonparametric confidence bands and derives lower-bound limitations under its Lipschitz-class coverage criteria.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the all-ones subclass in the width result with an explicitly defined, nondegenerate \boldsymbol\theta-indexed Gaussian-location submodel; prove that each member remains inside the stated panel class and define P_{\boldsymbol\theta_n} before taking its infima.

Stress-test the complexity upper bound against heterogeneous lead-specific direct variance shares; either derive the required uniform share comparability from primitive TWSF conditions or state the upper law using an appropriate maximum/aggregate share rather than only \nu_{\min,n}.

Add a formal singleton-menu, H_n=1 embedding of Shen’s published setup and state the inclusion explicitly, so the claimed strict tightening is against the cited class rather than only the proposal-defined selected-training class.

recommended_next_step: Revise the centered-rectangle lower-bound experiment into a legal parameter-varying TWSF submodel, then advance the field-tier growing-path and covariance kernel to Stage 0.
